basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software developer based in Seattle, originally from Chicago. I have a passion for technology and language learning, particularly Japanese, which I've been studying for the past two years. I work remotely, which allows me to keep a flexible schedule. I usually browse Reddit during my breaks throughout the day and late at night. I'm in a committed relationship, and we both share an interest in exploring different cultures through food and travel. I dislike negativity and trolling online, preferring constructive discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science from the University of Illinois and have been working in the tech industry for six years. My interest in Japanese started as a hobby but has grown into a serious pursuit, aided by online resources and apps. Recently, I've been exploring the intersection of technology and language learning.
